description: This file defines data types, classes, and validation logic for booking window configurations in a scheduling system, including different window types (business days, calendar days, date range) and a custom validator.

classes.name: BookingWindowBase
classes.description: Base class for booking window configurations with a type property.

classes.name: BusinessDaysWindow_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a booking window defined in business days, with optional rolling behavior.

classes.name: CalendarDaysWindow_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a booking window defined in calendar days, with optional rolling behavior.

classes.name: RangeWindow_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a booking window defined by a specific date range.

classes.name: BookingWindowValidator
classes.description: Custom validator class for validating booking window configurations.

methods.name: ValidateBookingWindow
methods.description: Decorator factory for applying the custom booking window validator.
